verses: Jab sooraj lapet liya jaye ga
Aur jab sitaray bey noor ho jayen gi
Aur jab pahar chalaye jayen gay
Aur jab das mah ki hamila oontniyan chor di jayen
Aur jab wehshi janwar ikhattay kiye jayen gay
Aur jab samandar bharkaye jayen gay
Aur jab janen (jismoon say) mila di jayen gi
Aur jab zindah gari hui larki say sawal kiya jaye ga
Kay kiss gunah ki wajah say woh qatal ki gaee?
Aur jab nama aemaal khol diye jayen gay
Aur jab aasman ki khal utaar li jaye gi
Aur jab jahannum bharkai jaye gi
Aur jab jannat nazdeek ker di jaye gi
To uss din her shakhs jaan ley ga jo kuch ley ker aaya hoga
Mein qasam khata hun peechay hatney walay
Chalney phirney walay chupney walay sitaron ki
Aur raat ki jab janey lagay
Aur subha ki jab chamek lagay
Yaqeenan yeh aik buzurg rasool ka kaha hua hai
Jo qooat wala hai, arsh walay (Allah) kay nazdeek buland martaba hai
Jiss ki (aasmano mein) ita’at ki jati hai amin hai
Aur tumhara sathi deewana nahi hai
Uss ney uss (farishtay) ko aasman kay khulay kinaray per dekha bhi hai
Aur yeh ghaib ki baaton ko batlaney mein bakheel bhi nahi
Aur yeh Quran shetan mardood ka kalaam nahi
Phir tum kahan jaa rahey ho
Yeh to tamam jahaan walon kay liye naseehat nama hai
(bilkhusoos) uss kay liye jo tum mein say seedhi raah per chalna chahaye
Aur tum baghair perwerdigar aalam kay chahaye kuch nahi chah saktay
